notes: Geely Australia currently sells three models: EX2 (BEV hatch), EX5 (BEV SUV), and Starray EM-i (PHEV, 1.5L petrol + battery - excluded, not a BEV). No Geely EX7, Preface, Monjaro, Emgrand or Galaxy Cruiser are on sale yet; these are announced/under consideration for 2026-2027 but not orderable, and excluded pending confirmation. EX5 received a battery/range update in 2026 (68.39kWh, up from an earlier 60.22kWh pack); the exact new kWh figure is sourced only from Drive.com.au (medium confidence) since geely.com.au itself does not publish the number, only range/performance claims - flagged. Both EX5 variants are explicitly stated by Geely/AEVA as not rated for towing (0kg), reported here as 0 rather than null since it is an explicit manufacturer statement. Pricing is RRP/MSRP before on-road costs as stated by geely.com.au, not driveaway.
